reviews.text: Professionals and good people, trying to help in any way they can and more

We have a Shih Tzu, and whenever we took her to a groomer, they told us she was a very difficult dog and that it was impossible to do a good job. Besides, she would come out trembling and didn't want to go back. A friend recommended a girl named Sagra who works at your salon, and we couldn't be happier. We've already taken our dog four times, and not only does she come out looking gorgeous, but she also leaves happy and wants to stay with Sagra at the groomer's. We are so grateful for the kindness and the way they treated our dog and us.
I called them about an urgent issue with my cat and they helped me. Thank you so much.
A highly prestigious veterinary center and a trusted veterinary clinic with an emergency clinic.

We went there for an emergency and we can say that they're going to become our trusted veterinarians. Just the way they treat the animals (all the staff in general, and Ana in particular) shows they're top-notch professionals. With our dog, they immediately knew what was wrong, and the treatment they gave her has made her recover very quickly. I definitely recommend this clinic for the best care for our furry companions!
Very attentive and caring, I will always recommend them.
Very professional

We took Buddy to the vet for a skin problem. After more than a month and five visits to another veterinarian, we found Ana, and on the first visit, we went home with a diagnosis, ending our uncertainty.

She told me to give him a month, and in that time, my canine friend improved significantly.

Our cat also had complications due to the dog's illness, so we took him as well. The result was the same: in just over a month, he was well (it took him a little longer because he's immunocompromised). Therefore, everyone at home is very grateful, and we will definitely return.
He's an excellent veterinarian. He's been in the profession for many years, and we've known him since the beginning. He's wonderful as a person and as a professional. My dogs always have his heart.

My one-year-old cat had a problem and wasn't walking well, and our regular vet couldn't treat him. I called, and they answered very quickly, without any waiting, and were very kind to him and reassured us.
Although he still has a ways to go before his full recovery, I'm very happy with them. Noelia was his vet at the time, and she explained everything to me.
They are very nice and attentive to pets and explain everything very well.
Very professional and honest.

I went once. Excellent service. They give you recommendations for anything you ask about. Very caring with your pet. I don't know the prices because it was my first time. But I thought they were reasonable.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for years. Years ago I wasn't happy, I think because of the staff, but in the last two years I've been very happy because they take care of Balto and are concerned about him.

I'm delighted with all the girls. Especially Helena and Noelia, who always treat my Enzo with the utmost care.
They're so attentive and always looking out for Enzo's well-being.
Thank you so much from both of us. ❤️

Excellent clinic. We took our sick cat there, and although it was our first time, they treated us with great empathy and professionalism. All the staff (from reception to the two veterinarians who saw our cat) were very kind. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

I've been going to this clinic for over three years now, and it's undoubtedly the best I've ever been to, both in terms of the veterinarians' kindness, the care and affection they show the animals, and their accurate diagnoses and results. I've had my dogs operated on twice for different conditions, and everything has gone wonderfully. They're also incredibly reasonable with their pricing. The prices have always been fair and, compared to other clinics, very competitive.

A huge hug to all of you—you're the best! From Brad, Angie, and Amparo.
Good service, the girls were very friendly.

I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less. My sister took her dog in for surgery to remove a wart, but they decided against it. They didn't notify my sister, and after hours of waiting, she finally called to say she could come in, but they hadn't done anything. They kept the dog for hours without notifying my sister or doing anything to him. He hadn't even eaten or drunk anything; he'd been fasting since the day before and came home barely drinking anything, not even the water from the flowerpot. Terrible service.

Let me explain what happened: I went because my dog ​​had a small wart, and since he'd had a tumor a while back, to prevent it from happening again, I took him in and scheduled an appointment to have it removed. I arrived at 10:00 AM, and at 1:53 PM I called because I hadn't heard from him since 10:00 AM. Imagine my surprise! I called and they told me they weren't operating, that he didn't have anything wrong with him. Four damn hours with the dog there and they didn't even call me, with a thousand excuses, and I was a nervous wreck. The dog has nothing wrong with him and you keep him there for four hours? Three different vets and none of them bothered to call? Well, I got home and the dog was drinking water and eating his fill, even though he normally eats very little. They probably didn't even give him water or food for those few hours. Is that a lack of dedication? It's shameful and disrespectful. On top of that, they ask me if it's true that I should have called but I went in to operate on another dog? Is it really that hard to call for two minutes? To not keep the dog there for four hours? Do you need another vet to see if he's fit for surgery? Haven't you studied enough to know for yourself? That's awful. I didn't make a scene because I don't want my dog ​​to see me upset. I just hope nothing comes out of it, because I'll be preparing lawyers.
Excellent service and very professional.
Very professional and they treat my Toby with great care

Seven days ago, my faithful companion went to heaven, and with a heavy heart, I must express my gratitude for the care, the affection, and above all, the efficiency with which Areta was treated. A million thanks for the attention she received from the first minute to the last from the veterinary team at the center, to Noelia and especially to Tamara. Thank you from the bottom of my heart; it was a great pleasure to have known you. For now, I don't have the spirit or strength to have another companion, but if I ever have one again, we will be walking through your door from the very first moment. Until we meet again.

Isaac and Areta.
Very good advice

I've been there several times because it's close and convenient, but I'm never going back. They're just money-grubbers and incompetent.

They don't have any specialist professionals; they rent out their treatment rooms and bring in outsiders, so they triple the prices for services. It's shameful!

A bath for a small, short-haired dog cost €22, and they only spent 20 minutes on him. When they told me it should be €15, I pointed it out, but they just kept repeating the same thing, so I decided to leave and not argue anymore.

It's very sad that they operate this way and rip off their customers like this.
I'm always very happy with how all the girls treat both me and my pets.
They are all truly lovely; you feel like you're leaving your four-legged friend's health in very good hands.

Terrible experience. After taking my pet there for vaccinations and checkups for many years, I always thought they were money-grubbing and eager to take advantage of the prices. But when my pet needed surgery, I realized that not only do they inflate their prices significantly compared to other professionals, but they also have very little empathy for both pets and their owners. A clear lack of dedication.
I am completely dissatisfied with this clinic. I absolutely do not recommend it. I switched to another veterinary center, and it was the best decision I could have made. The professionals there explain the procedures, reassure you, and don't pressure you simply to make money.
This is the second time I've posted this review. I hope it doesn't disappear again.
I took my senior dog in for surgery with the risk that she might not survive. I am grateful to the clinic staff, especially Noe, for their professionalism and empathy towards owners and pets.
They are excellent professionals, I give them 5 stars because I can't give more. Thank you so much 😊 …
Super friendly

I can only say THANK YOU. Yesterday we called to see if they could sell us medicine, as animal shelters like Modepran were requesting these products due to the devastating effects of the DANA storm. When we arrived, they donated a whole bag full of medicine, which went directly to Modepran. Thank you to the entire team at this center for your contribution to the animals.
I take my dog ​​there and they always treat him very well, very professional.
I take care of my cat there. Everything is excellent.
Good guys, you can trust them.

Disclaimer: the center is nice and there are a lot of good vets.

I had a revision appointment at 12:00. I came at 11:55 and was ready to show my …

It's so great to find this clinic! The staff is wonderful, the clinic is large, clean, and beautiful—a place where our pets are happy and well cared for.
Thank you so much for being this wonderful.
Good service and very friendly treatment.
Very nice

When we talk about pets, many of us consider them part of the family, and as such, you want the best professional care, but you also want them to be treated with respect and love. That's where this clinic truly shines 💕 …
